status: Exposed development remeasurement protocol, saved before revised measurements and scores. Original scans, annotations and aggregate scores have already been seen.
selection: All 33 canonical names in the unchanged six-recto pilot and the same 33 modern tokens; no replacement or outside partners.
motivation: Visual inspection suggests wrong-location historical annotations at 18:45 and 44:42. Audit every selected name, not only these cases.
convention: Resize each source to 1000px width with Pillow and rounded proportional height. Manually read the left/right extent of the entire lexical token's baseline-connected letter bodies, including attached prefixes and elongations, excluding detached vocalization/recitation marks. Use the midpoint. This is an operational manual body-center convention, not a complete-ink or detector-box convention.
frame: Manually read the horizontal envelope of verse-text letter bodies across the page; exclude frames, headings, head basmalas, markers and foliation. One constant width per physical page. No deskew or perspective correction.

uncertainty.interpretation: Uncalibrated working allowances, not statistical confidence intervals.

metrics.partners: Selected names on different physical rows of the same physical page only; endpoint counts, not pair counts.

review: Single assistant scan rereading. Full-page context and full-width row strips without old x boxes. Modern row-strip selection may use existing detector y support. Record physical rows and historical row-end anchors. Prior exposure prevents blind/independent status. Colophon adjudication, independent second reader, full lexical row transcription and historical production modeling remain separate requirements.
exclusions: Keep every occurrence. Unreadable identity/body bounds must be explicitly unresolved rather than replaced. Do not calculate complete paired counts unless all 66 locations are supplied.
inference: Descriptive measurement sensitivity and annotation audit only; no p-value or origin probability. No held-out or independent-adjudication claim. Frozen earlier artifacts are not overwritten.
